items.headline: Iranian President Signals Readiness for Peace Talks Amid Regional Tensions

items.headline: Nvidia Invests $3.5 Billion in MediaTek to Expand Custom AI Chip Production

items.headline: 83rd Venice International Film Festival Kicks Off in Italy
items.summary: The 83rd Venice International Film Festival opens on September 2, 2026, marking the official start of the global fall film awards season. Running through September 12, the festival features 21 films in main competition for the Golden Lion award, alongside lifetime achievement honors for George Clooney and Ellen Burstyn.
